topics.topic: Behavior of accept_binding on an already accepted binding whose pinned manifest digest no longer matches
questions: If a binding is already `accepted` and its manifest operation digest no longer matches the pin, should `accept_binding` return it unchanged or refuse it as stale?
If `accept_binding` is called on a binding already in `accepted` status and its pinned manifest digest no longer matches, must the call return it unchanged or refuse as stale?

topics.topic: Handling oversized 2xx response bodies when a binding defines zero output ports
questions: For a 2xx response to a binding with no output ports, does an oversized body get ignored (success) or fail as `contract_violation`?

topics.topic: How guard evaluation works when the guard source value has cardinality many (list)
questions: If a guard port value is `many` (list), is guard comparison evaluated per element, on the whole list, or prohibited by proof?

topics.topic: Media type assigned to non-file multipart form parts for request_digest computation
questions: What media type is assigned to non-file value parts in multipart bodies (and therefore included in `request_digest`)?

topics.topic: Output reporting requirements for non-terminal runs (include all outputs with reasons vs only produced outputs)
questions: For runs in `running`/`awaiting_approval`/`pending`, must the response include all flow outputs with reasons (`skipped_by_guard`/`not_produced`), or only produced outputs and no per-output reasons until end?

topics.topic: Port ordering and boundary/tie reporting rules when request-shape validation finds manifest mismatches
questions: When validating request shape, is ordering over only input ports, or inputs then outputs, and how are ties/phase boundaries reported when both sides fail?

topics.topic: Precedence ordering when multiple pre-send failure conditions are simultaneously true
questions: Inside this grouped check, what is the exact precedence when multiple conditions are true (e.g., missing instance and unresolved credential)?

topics.topic: Required cardinality and pre-call validated/stored shape of a mapped node’s map_over input
questions: For a mapped node, must the `map_over` input port be cardinality `one` or `many`, and what shape is validated/stored before per-element calls?

topics.topic: Whether capture-from-run is allowed after run end for failed node executions in non-failed terminal runs
questions: Is capture from a failed NodeExecution in an ended non-`failed` run (e.g., `refused`/`cancelled`) always refused, even when needed inputs are non-file values still in store?

topics.topic: Whether one invalid produced output invalidates delivery of all outputs from the same node attempt
questions: If one output value of a producing node violates its source port schema, are other outputs from that same node attempt still deliverable when valid, or is the whole node attempt treated as having no delivered outputs?
